result.title: Measure Neural Mappings
result.summary: We introduce and define measure neural mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency for learning operators on probability measures. Ensemble consistency requires outputs from growing ensembles sampled from an input law to converge to the specified population output in probability. We establish quantitative continuum limits for attention on noncompact laws under strong sub-Gaussian and tail-integrability assumptions. These laws accommodate unbounded state spaces in scientific machine learning, including Bayesian inference and uncertainty quantification. For fixed self-attention transformers, the expected output Wasserstein error is bounded by the empirical input Wasserstein error plus an additional $N^{-1/2}$ attention term. These self-attention transformers are MNMs under the stated assumptions: pre-norm architectures follow from compact stability after normalization, while post-norm architectures are covered under the stated tail conditions. We prove corresponding cross-attention estimates and extend the results to multihead attention and grouped transformer evaluation, with convergence as the group size grows. For Set Transformers viewed as measure-to-vector mappings, we obtain an $N^{-1/2}$ bound on the expected Euclidean output error under the stated assumptions. Experiments on seven operators in dimensions $d=1,2,3,5,10$ support the predicted particle-count dependence, using one-dimensional Wasserstein computations and Sinkhorn approximations in higher dimensions. The observed Wasserstein and sliced Wasserstein decay rates are close to their respective theoretical sampling benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文定义 measure neural mappings（MNMs），把自注意力/交叉注意力与 Set Transformer 刻画为概率测度上的算子，在非紧支撑律与尾部可积假设下证明随系综或粒子数 N 增长的 Wasserstein/欧氏误差收敛界（含 N^{-1/2} 项），并在 d=1…10 的七个算子上验证粒子数依赖。
AI.relevance_reason: 把注意力视为测度到向量的聚合映射并给出系综一致性与 N^{-1/2} 收敛估计，可能为分析 LVR 中随证据/序列长度增长的 latent 状态聚合、注意力结构与长度泛化提供理论工具，但原文不含视觉推理任务，可供核查。
